description:
FOUND s500a (Opus, 2026-09-30) while splicing the #2533 companion movers.  t/comp/proto.t's snapshot row in baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv says C 78/38 (s473t5c, abort "Undefined subroutine &main::FOO called"); measured `tools/run-perl-suite.pl --jobs 1 comp/proto.t` on git-archive extractions:

    558cc5a0 (main at s500 start)   C 63/32   abort: Can't use string ("a") as an ARRAY ref while "strict refs" in use
    1bae682b (main after s500p+s494h) C 63/32   same abort
    s500a tree (#2533)               C 75/20   same abort (12 prototype rows UP; spliced with this note)

So 21 rows (116 -> 95 produced; the runner's SHORTFALL line "100 -> 121 NEVER PRODUCED") were lost BEFORE 558cc5a0, at an unknown commit, and the file now aborts on a different statement.  The runner's ROW DIFF lists the rows that went missing/failing (NEW ROW comp/proto.t #96 #97 #99 #100 #101, "$1 containing CORE::Foo", star "FOO" / star $star / star("FOO") / star($star) / star(FOO) / star2 FOO, BAR) -- they are NEW on the base too.
TO DO: bisect with the same one-file command over the snapshot's s473t5c commit .. 558cc5a0 (git archive extractions; ~1 min per step), find the commit, attribute, fix or file; then re-splice the row.  Note "pre-existing is WHEN, not WHY" -- the s500a splice records WHEN only.
subject: t/comp/proto.t lost 21 rows BEFORE 558cc5a0 (snapshot 78/38, measured 63/32 on 558cc5a0 and 1bae682b; the file now aborts on `Can't use string ("a") as an ARRAY ref`) -- not bisected
